build.command:
rtk proxy C:/Python313/python.exe -X utf8 -c 'from pathlib import Path
import tempfile,shutil,subprocess,json,hashlib,sys
root=Path.cwd()
stage=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="okto-r4-native-build-"))
dist=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="okto-r4-native-wheel-"))
shutil.copytree(root/"src",stage/"src",ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__","*.egg-info"))
for name in ("pyproject.toml","README.md","LICENSE"):
 if (root/name).exists(): shutil.copy2(root/name,stage/name)
command=[sys.executable,"-m","pip","wheel",str(stage),"--no-deps","--no-build-isolation","--wheel-dir",str(dist)]
built=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
(root/"plans/r4_execution/evidence/native-actions-build.log").write_text(built.stdout+built.stderr,encoding="utf-8")
assert built.returncode==0
wheel=next(dist.glob("okto_nexus-*.whl"))
previous=json.loads((root/"plans/r4_execution/evidence/mcp-capabilities-artifacts.json").read_text())
env=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="okto-r4-native-installed-"))
subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-m","venv",str(env)],check=True)
python=env/"Scripts/python.exe"
versions=previous["requirements"]
requirements="\n".join(f"{name}=={version}" for name,version in sorted(versions.items()) if name.lower().replace("_","-") not in ("okto-nexus","okto-nexus-connector","nexus-connector-core"))+"\n"
req=env/"requirements.txt";req.write_text(requirements,encoding="utf-8")
commands=[[str(python),"-m","pip","install","-r",str(req)],[str(python),"-m","pip","install","--no-deps",str(wheel),previous["connector"]["wheel"],previous["core"]["wheel"]]]
runs=[]
for command in commands:
 proc=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
 runs.append(dict(command=command,exit_code=proc.returncode,stdout=proc.stdout,stderr=proc.stderr))
 if proc.returncode: break
(root/"plans/r4_execution/evidence/native-actions-installation.json").write_text(json.dumps(runs,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
assert all(r["exit_code"]==0 for r in runs)
previous.update(python=str(python),environment=str(env),requirements_sha256=hashlib.sha256(req.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
previous["nexus"]={"stage":str(stage),"wheel":str(wheel),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(wheel.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(root/"plans/r4_execution/evidence/native-actions-artifacts.json").write_text(json.dumps(previous,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"wheel":str(wheel),"sha256":previous["nexus"]["sha256"],"python":str(python)},indent=2))
'

installed.command:
rtk proxy C:/Users/jpamb/AppData/Local/Temp/okto-r4-native-installed-zk_r383i/Scripts/python.exe -I -X utf8 -c 'import json,hashlib,zipfile,sys,platform
from pathlib import Path
import pytest,okto_nexus,okto_nexus_connector,nexus_connector_core
root=Path("D:/Projetos/Techridy/okto_labs_okto_nexus")
connector=root.parent/"okto-nexus-connector"
artifacts=json.loads((root/"plans/r4_execution/evidence/native-actions-artifacts.json").read_text())
manifest={}
for module,key,source in [(okto_nexus,"nexus",root/"src"),(okto_nexus_connector,"connector",connector/"src"),(nexus_connector_core,"core",None)]:
 package=Path(module.__file__).resolve().parent
 artifact=Path(artifacts[key]["wheel"])
 assert "site-packages" in package.parts
 assert hashlib.sha256(artifact.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==artifacts[key]["sha256"]
 files={}
 with zipfile.ZipFile(artifact) as archive:
  for name in archive.namelist():
   if not name.startswith(module.__name__+"/") or name.endswith("/"): continue
   data=archive.read(name)
   assert (package/name.split("/",1)[1]).read_bytes()==data,name
   if source is not None: assert (source/name).read_bytes()==data,name
   files[name]=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
 manifest[module.__name__]={"path":str(package),"wheel_sha256":artifacts[key]["sha256"],"files_sha256":files}
manifest.update(python=sys.version,platform=platform.platform(),isolated=bool(sys.flags.isolated),
 scope="Native HTTP and managed MCP canonical domain actions; synthetic qualification/READY fixture, no host/provider acceptance.")
(root/"plans/r4_execution/evidence/native-actions-installed-modules.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
args=["-c","pytest.ini","--rootdir="+str(root/"tests"),"--confcutdir="+str(root/"tests"),"-o","asyncio_mode=auto"]
args.extend(str(connector/"tests"/p) for p in ["unit/test_r4_session_capability.py","unit/test_redaction.py","unit/test_r4_execution.py","contract/test_r4_connection.py","contract/test_wss_r4.py"])
args.extend(str(root/"tests/execution_r4"/p) for p in ["test_native_actions.py","test_mcp_session_capabilities.py","test_session_capabilities.py","test_ns02.py","test_ns03.py","test_ns09.py","test_ns10.py","test_open_bootstrap.py","test_canonical_controls.py","test_remote_connection.py"])
args.extend(str(root/"tests"/p) for p in ["test_agent_connections.py","test_http_parity.py"])
args.extend(["-q","--tb=short","--junitxml="+str(root/"plans/r4_execution/evidence/native-actions-installed.xml")])
raise SystemExit(pytest.main(args))
'
